name: Service-Volée
text: player profiles, ranking forecasts, match counter and provisional results.
body: Service-Volée takes the federation's public data and makes it readable: every player has a profile, a history, their six best results and a ranking projection. A mobile match counter lets you umpire and share a live score.
Stack: Next.js, Postgres (Neon), scheduled crawler, installable PWA, account area with magic link.

name: BibliPulse
text: cover scanning, duplicate detection, shareable to-read pile.
body: BibliPulse lets a reader catalogue their library by scanning barcodes, avoid duplicates and share their to-read pile publicly. Over 300 sign-ups through organic growth.
Stack: React, Supabase, PWA, static pre-rendering for SEO, automated onboarding emails.

name: Beneloo Observatory
lead: the observatory of Belgian SME visibility
text: in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, sector by sector.
body: The Observatory queries four AI models with frozen prompts over exhaustive samples of companies (accountants, plumbers…) and measures who is cited, who is hallucinated, who is invisible. Result: over 96% of local SMEs never appear.
Stack: Python, Postgres, immutable campaign pipeline, human validation, anonymised reports.

name: Iris Noir Bruxelles
lead: the website of the Brussels crime-fiction fair,
text: shop, press and programme included, moved off WordPress.
body: Complete redesign of the Iris Noir non-profit's website: fair programme, authors, press, shop with cart and ordering, contact form. Content migrated from the old WordPress, classic shared hosting.
Stack: React, JSON content, lightweight PHP API, automated deployment.

name: Royal Wellington
lead: the redesign of a hockey, tennis and padel club's website,
body: Editorial and technical review of the Royal Wellington Club website: disciplines, memberships, selections, private hire, physiotherapy. Content validated section by section with the club.
Stack: TanStack Start, Cloudflare Workers, trilingual content.

name: Beneloo
text: the Beneloo Score measures an SME's visibility in AI engines and says what to fix.
body: Beneloo is the brand under which I support Belgian SMEs on AI visibility: diagnosis, six-pillar score, action plan, follow-up. The website, the prospecting portal and the observatory are tools I built myself.
Stack: Next.js, Supabase, OpenAI and Perplexity, prospecting pipeline.
